name: The World Around Us
summary: Every hero knows that mastery of the world around them is a must to survive. The librarian may have things to say...

steps.journal: Falcon says the fighting is only half of it. Archivist Maelis keeps the Archive in town, and he knows how this world works.
Maelis says an adventurer learns the world by walking it and talking to people. He sent me to Mother Hesk at The Perch, the tall stone inn on the east side of town.

objectives.text: Speak with Mother Hesk at The Perch

steps.journal: Mother Hesk had plenty to say about the Cathedrals, and a question nobody seems to ask. Back to Maelis.
